Discover

Your own place in
Vicolo Monteleone

Mont°6 is a self-contained apartment for two guests in the pedestrian old town of Cefalù. Two minutes on foot from the Cathedral, five from the beach, thirty seconds from the restaurants.

One bedroom, one bathroom, a proper kitchen, exposed beams and Sicilian tiled floors. Air conditioning throughout, fibre broadband, linens and towels included. You let yourself in with the digital lock, any time from 3pm.

Explore Cefalù

A few places to explore on foot between a swim and dinner.

La Rocca

270 metres up, about 40 minutes. At the top, the ruins of the Norman castle and the gulf.

The Medieval Laundry

A stone staircase drops below street level to the Cefalino river. Two minutes from the door.

The beach

Five minutes on foot. Sand, shallow water, and the fishing harbour at one end.

The Cathedral

Begun in 1131, Byzantine mosaics in the apse. UNESCO listed since 2015.
